scientific_question: At matched independent-parent budgets and identical generated two-view streams, does Dynamic JS (lambda=60) outperform Dynamic ERM?

data.test_role: already used by the main study; supplementary post-main follow-up, not an untouched confirmatory test

subset_selection.rank: SHA256(parent-structure-efficiency-v1 NUL selection_seed NUL crystal_system NUL parent_structure_id)
subset_selection.apportionment: Hamilton largest remainder at each exact budget; ties follow CRYSTAL_SYSTEMS order; per-class prefixes form nested subsets

matrix.execution_order: for each seed in listed order, finish all four budgets and both paired methods before the next seed

training.batching: full batches only; deterministic shuffled cycles can cross cycle boundaries
training.pairing: within each budget and seed, initialize ERM and JS from identical model weights and render one ordered two-view batch shared by both methods at every step
training.historical_budget_basis: 49280 is the median selected-best-checkpoint global_step among the 10 available historical V9 checkpoints (steps are not the missing historical terminal-step record); it is a new common supplementary budget, not a V9 reproduction
training.checkpoint_selection: highest mean validation single-factor OOD Macro-F1 across six profiles on validation split at evaluation seed 20260721; ties use higher validation in-range Macro-F1 then earlier step

performance.selection_basis: local end-to-end benchmark comparing the historical 8/8 formal default with higher-prefetch alternatives before any scientific run

torch_compile.reason: historical laptop probe found no working Triton installation

evaluation.primary: mean single-factor OOD Macro-F1 across 6 profiles, 3 evaluation seeds, and the unchanged formal Test parents
evaluation.prediction: one generated view per parent and profile; softmax probabilities; same convention as frozen simulated-Test panel evaluation

resources.gpu: use available local CUDA GPU; no cloud compute or purchases
resources.output_root: <explicit local ignored directory outside tracked source>
resources.checkpoint_policy: keep last and validation-selected best checkpoints outside Git

interpretation.same_budget_gain: report matched-seed JS minus ERM differences at each measured parent count
interpretation.data_savings: only estimate equivalent-parent counts when the target is bracketed by measured points; no extrapolation
interpretation.claim_boundary: same-budget performance improvement does not by itself establish fewer-parent data efficiency
